Intel DG2-512

DG2-512
CGI Die Shot
Block Diagram
Render Slice
Xe-core
Intel's DG2-512 GPU uses the Xe-HPG architecture and is made using a 6 nm production process at TSMC. With a die size of 406 mm² and a transistor count of 21.7 billion it is a large chip. DG2-512 supports DirectX 12 Ultimate (Feature Level 12_2). It also supports OpenGL 4.6 and Vulkan 1.4. For GPU compute applications, OpenCL version 3.0 can be used. Additionally, the DirectX 12 Ultimate capability guarantees support for hardware-raytracing, variable-rate shading and more, in upcoming video games. It features 4096 shading units, 256 texture mapping units and 128 ROPs. Also included are 512 XMX Cores which help improve the speed of machine learning applications with support for the INT2, INT4 and INT8 data formats. The GPU also contains 32 raytracing acceleration cores.
